entry.title: New: BILL049(25) (Honolulu) — PUBLISH
entry.content:
RELATING TO REAL PROPERTY TAXATION.

Amends real property tax homeowner’s exemption for taxpayers 65 years of age or over. Effective upon approval and applies to tax years beginning July 1,2027, and thereafter.

Latest action: Final reading notice published in the Honolulu Star-Advertiser.
